## One small change

Use `ProjectSourceMaterials(factory, scope, root, source_mappings)` for the local
read port. Each mapping is a complete SourceRef plus an explicit safe relative
file path. Retain the baseline rule that the host selects only a finite set of
refs in one scope, and that the source port is read-only. Replace only the
baseline's document-ID-to-file-path inference. Two versions of one document now
have two explicit paths, so the caller can preserve both captures without
overwriting either. There is no automatic source registration or copying by the
source port; the caller authors and retains the files.

def test_same_document_versions_require_distinct_explicit_files(tmp_path):
    old = b"DID: old revision\n"
    new = b"DID: new revision\n"
    (tmp_path / "archive").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "archive" / "v1.md").write_bytes(old)
    (tmp_path / "current.md").write_bytes(new)
    old_ref = _source("design.md", old, version="v1")
    new_ref = _source("design.md", new, version="v2")
    reader = ProjectSourceMaterials(object(), scope=SCOPE, root=tmp_path,
        source_mappings=((old_ref, "archive/v1.md"), (new_ref, "current.md")))
    try:
        assert reader.read(_context(), old_ref) == old
        assert reader.read(_context(), new_ref) == new
        missing = _source("design.md", b"unavailable", version="v3")
        with pytest.raises(ApplicationError, match="SOURCE_VERSION_MISMATCH"):
            reader.read(_context(), missing)
    finally:
        reader.close()

retained bytes. Two versions with the same locator therefore resolve to the
same path. If version v1 and v2 have different bytes, that one file cannot supply

def request_and_run_review(env, *, run_cleanup=None):
    requested = asyncio.run(env.service.execute('engineering.reviews.request',
        {'plan':decode_json(encode_plan(env.plan))}, context('request-source-review')))
    with env.factory.begin(SCOPE, 'read') as uow:
        request = uow.reviews.get_request(env.plan.review_id)
    async def run_once():
        try:
            return await env.reviewer.run_review(context('run-source-review'), env.plan, request)
        finally:
            if run_cleanup is not None:
                await run_cleanup()
    raw_ref = asyncio.run(run_once())
    receipt = decode_json(env.blobs.read_verified(raw_ref))
    try:
        recorded = asyncio.run(env.service.execute('engineering.reviews.record', {
            'review_id':env.plan.review_id, 'request_version':request.version,
            'fence':request.fence, 'raw_response_utf8':env.blobs.read_verified(raw_ref).decode()},
            context('record-source-review')))
    except ApplicationError as exc:
        # Native completion survives a later Engineering admission refusal.
        # Retain the original run identity for the bounded probe's cold reader.
        exc.decision_run_id = receipt['run_id']
        exc.decision_status = 'completed'
        raise
    return requested, recorded, receipt

def associate_and_freeze(env, proposal_ref, review_ref):
    associated = asyncio.run(env.service.execute('engineering.proposals.associate_review', {
        'proposal_ref':asdict(proposal_ref), 'expected_version':1, 'review_ref':asdict(review_ref)},
        context('associate-source-review')))
    successor = decode_proposal_ref(associated.result['proposal_ref'])
    documents = tuple(PackageDocument(role, env.mappings[i][0])
                      for role,i in (('spec',2),('plan',3),('tasks',4)))
    package = ImplementationPackage(SCOPE, 'caller-prepared-package', NOW, AUTHOR,
        PreparedPackagePayload(env.baseline, env.candidate, successor, (review_ref,),
                               env.method, env.resources, documents))
    wire = decode_json(encode_package(package))
    frozen = asyncio.run(env.service.execute('engineering.packages.freeze',
        {'record':wire}, context('freeze-source-package')))
    assert frozen.result['dispatchable'] is False
    return successor, package, wire, frozen

## Itemized review boundary

This input proposes no production authority or new review engine. Method 2.7.2 fixes eight required pair-level checks. The caller supplies each claim and exact cited text separately; JEV supplies only a finite choice per check. Existing Engineering owners bind original native answers to materials and aggregate all required results. Neither caller assertions nor retrievable citations are automatically accepted. Missing items refuse; unknown never passes. Complex design reasoning belongs to the author and independent reviewer agents. This material does not claim that the new itemized code has already passed real JEV review.
